Custom Attributes: define global Supplier or Store attributes; ID, Name and display Format; spaces in names are stored as underscores; values are maintained per Supplier/Store in Manage; attributes become available to Custom Reports through SupplierID/StoreID.

Custom Reports: create reports on active Custom Views; owner/name/description/active state; all-users or selected-user access; Report Fields with header, Field Type, Custom Format and None/Sum/Average/Count/Min/Max; automatic grouping when aggregation is used; Store/Supplier Custom Attributes; Order By; report deletion blocked while Reporting Scheduler tasks use it.

Custom Views: the DBA first creates an approved public-schema base reporting view named vw_*; IMS then registers it in cr_views, loads its columns, assigns one of 12 Field Types, controls Active status, and exposes it as the data-source layer for Custom Reports. Deletion is blocked while reports use the view.
